The *liquidity threshold breach* is essentially the same issue, but framed as a violation of an *internal* policy metric: "unrestricted cash" falling below CHF 100,000. It's essentially the same violation as the covenant breach. I'm tagging it as a separate signal. Same high confidence (0.98).
